cue_target_interval_ms.description: Interval from cue onset to array onset. 0 = no cue. Requires `stimulus_set.cue` other than "none".

feedback_duration_ms.description: How long trial feedback stays on screen.

fixation_duration_ms.description: Fixation duration; 0 = no fixation. A `{min, max, step}` object draws a uniform jitter per trial.

iti_ms.description: Blank interval after the trial (and its feedback); 0 = none.

response_window_ms.description: Time allowed to respond, from array onset; null = untimed. Misses are recorded as `timeout: true`.

observed.value: individualized from practice mean RT (-1 SD speed / +1 SD both / +3 SD accuracy)

soa_ms.description: Onset asynchrony between flankers and target. Negative: flankers first; positive: target first. 0 = simultaneous. During the lead the other items are hidden; RT is measured from full-array onset.

stimulus_duration_ms.description: How long the array stays visible; null = until response (or the response window ends).

stimulus_color.description: Colours as "<foreground> on <background>", any CSS colour names (e.g. "black on grey").

flanker_spacing.description: Gap between neighbouring items, in `unit`, or `"adjacent"` (no gap). A list is drawn from per trial (balanced) and recorded in `flanker_distance`. (default: { gap: 2, unit: "px" } — PEBL flanker defaults, S019)

array_position.description: Where the array sits relative to the fixation point. (default: "centre_at_fixation" — S019/S012)

orientation.description: Array axis. (default: "horizontal" — PEBL flanker defaults, S019)

stimulus_layout.description: Array geometry. Keys given here replace the matching default keys.

target.description: Target and flanker material. `"arrows"`, or `{ letters: [[...], [...]] }`: the letters that map to the first and to the second response. (default: "arrows" — PEBL flanker defaults, S019)

flanker.description: Flankers per side of the target: one number, or a list from which each trial draws (balanced). (default: { per_side: 2 } — PEBL flanker defaults, S019; 2 per side in 4 of the 7 studies that report it)

neutral_flanker.description: Form of the flankers on `neutral` trials; a list is used in rotation. The `neutral_dash` and `neutral_empty` trial types ignore it. (default: "dashes" — PEBL flanker defaults, S019)

cue.description: Warning cue form. (default: "none" — PEBL flanker defaults, S019 has no cue)

stimulus_set.description: Stimulus material, keyed by the task's own terms: target, flanker, neutral_flanker, cue.

observed.value: pictures (neutral target, valenced distractor pictures; location task)

stimulus_size.description: Size of each item. "deg" needs `screen_calibration` (otherwise 37.8 px per degree is assumed); "screen_height_fraction" is relative to the window height.

targets_per_response.description: With letters: how many different letters map to each response (1 or 2).

concurrent_task.description: Secondary task. Only "none" is implemented; compose with the simon-task package for the others.

condition_proportions.description: Proportion of each trial type per block, keyed by trial type (and optionally cued/uncued). Normalised to sum 1; counts per block use largest remainders. Must agree with `condition_set`.

observed.value: item-specific: MC items 75% congruent, MI items 25% congruent

items.description: Trial types. `neutral` uses `stimulus_set.neutral_flanker`; the two `neutral_*` types fix the form.

condition_set.description: Trial types included. `neutral` stands for any neutral form. If both this and `condition_proportions` are given they must name the same types.

defaultChanged.reason: must agree with the condition_proportions default, whose keys are PEBL's neutral_dash and neutral_empty
fill-in from other studies; PEBL runs its 160 test trials as one block

n_test_trials.description: Scored test trials in total (split over blocks; each block is balanced).

trial_order.description: Order within a block: "shuffled_list" (balanced list, shuffled), "random" (independent draws), "fixed_sequence" (balanced list cycling through the conditions).

response_device.description: "keyboard" keys; "mouse" and "touch" use on-screen buttons. Others are not implemented. (default: "keyboard" — PEBL's "auto" (S019) picks the device at run time; keyboard is the first choice)

defaultChanged.reason: PEBL 'auto' picks the device at run time and is not a value of the enum; keyboard is the first choice

response_hand.description: Which hand(s) respond. Only affects the instructions.

response_keys.description: Keys for the first (left) and second (right) response; arrow keys as `"ArrowLeft"`.

defaultChanged.reason: fill-in (2/11); PEBL's browser keys (S135) are the anchor; native left/right shift cannot be told apart by jsPsych

response_mapping_counterbalancing.description: Letter-to-key mapping across participants (only matters with letters; arrows map spatially): "fixed", "random_per_participant" (drawn once), "within_participant" (reverses every other block).

attention_checks.description: "instructed_items" adds two instructed-response probes before the task. Others are not implemented.

device_eligibility.description: "computer_only" ends the experiment on touch-only devices. Others are not implemented.

defaultChanged.reason: spec default was an untyped fill-in ([fullscreen]); PEBL has no restriction

practice_trials.description: Practice trials before the test; 0 = no practice. One balanced block.

rest_breaks.description: Break between test blocks: "self_paced" shows a screen with a continue button. Has no effect with one block. (default: "none" — PEBL has no breaks; the spec's fill-in "self_paced" (3/4) only applies with several blocks)

defaultChanged.reason: fill-in (3/4); PEBL has no breaks, and it is inert with one block

screen_calibration.description: Size calibration. "credit_card" and "virtual_chinrest" run the jsPsych virtual chinrest plugin and convert "deg" units.

block_feedback.description: Summary screen after each test block.

feedback_condition.description: On which trials trial feedback is shown (timeouts count as errors). Ignored when `trial_feedback` is "none".

trial_feedback.description: What trial feedback shows. "points" and "reward_outcome" are not implemented.

defaultChanged.reason: PEBL gives no feedback in the test phase; the content component's accuracy_rt becomes the practice default (practice: { trial_feedback: 'accuracy_rt' })

instruction_format.description: "text" shows instruction pages; "experimenter" shows none (the experimenter explains). Others are not implemented.

practice.description: Overrides for the practice phase. Honoured: trial_feedback, feedback_condition, feedback_duration_ms, response_window_ms, fixation_duration_ms, iti_ms, stimulus_duration_ms, soa_ms, cue_target_interval_ms, condition_set, condition_proportions, trial_order, stimulus_set, stimulus_layout, stimulus_size, stimulus_color, targets_per_response. Other keys are ignored in practice.

x-jspsych.note: Practice-phase overrides (PACKAGE-STANDARD 2a). Honoured keys are those with phaseOverridable true.

text.description: Custom text strings for translation. Partial objects are merged with defaults.

x-jspsych.note: Translation strings; see the Translation section of the site page.
